description: Hemoglobin is a protein in your red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body.
lowIndications: Low hemoglobin levels might indicate anemia, blood loss, or iron deficiency.
highIndications: High hemoglobin levels might indicate polycythemia vera, lung disease, or dehydration.
simplifiedExplanation: This measures the oxygen-carrying capacity of your blood. Think of it as the delivery trucks for oxygen in your body.

description: White blood cells are a key part of your immune system, helping your body fight infections.
lowIndications: A low WBC count (leukopenia) may indicate bone marrow problems or auto-immune disorders.
highIndications: A high WBC count typically indicates the body is fighting an infection, inflammation, or stress.
simplifiedExplanation: These are your body's tiny soldiers. High counts usually mean they are busy fighting off germs.

description: Measures the amount of glucose (sugar) in your blood after fasting for several hours.
lowIndications: Hypoglycemia (low blood sugar) can cause dizziness or sweating.
highIndications: Hyperglycemia (high blood sugar) is a key indicator of pre-diabetes or diabetes.
simplifiedExplanation: This measures how much fuel (sugar) is currently in your blood. Too much sugar can be like too much pressure in a pipe.

referenceRange: Less than 200 mg/dL (Desirable), 200-239 mg/dL (Borderline High), 240+ mg/dL (High)
description: A measure of the total amount of cholesterol in your blood.
lowIndications: Very low cholesterol is rare but can be linked to malnutrition or liver disease.
highIndications: High cholesterol increases the risk of heart disease and stroke.
simplifiedExplanation: Cholesterol is a waxy substance in your blood. Imagine it as grease that can build up in your body's plumbing.

referenceRange: 0.7 to 1.3 mg/dL for men, 0.6 to 1.1 mg/dL for women
description: Creatinine is a waste product from muscle wear and tear that is filtered by the kidneys.
lowIndications: Low levels are rare and often related to low muscle mass or pregnancy.
highIndications: High levels usually suggest that the kidneys are not filtering blood as efficiently as they should.
simplifiedExplanation: This shows how well your kidneys are cleaning your blood. High levels mean the 'filter' might be getting clogged.
